title: Figures 85-86: Tic Tac Mach number at 1100 mph and pressure at 1300 mph CFD plots
description: Two CFD contour plots for the Tic Tac UAP at 1/6 scale and 223K. Figure 85 shows Mach number distribution at 1100 mph with supersonic inlet/outlet, with a subsonic pocket behind the body; Figure 86 shows the pressure field (Pa) at 1300 mph with a strong bow shock. From the BAASS supersonic Tic Tac simulations.
